text: 金十数据9月10日讯，中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理何立峰10日在天津出席矿业国际合作部长论坛暨2026中国国际矿业大会开幕式并致辞。何立峰指出，矿业国际合作是实现各国资源优势互补、促进经济社会发展的重要载体，也是维护全球产供链安全稳定的现实需要。中国始终充分尊重各国矿产资源主权，支持各国自主选择符合本国国情的资源开发、产业发展道路，愿同各国深化全方位务实合作，共享矿业发展机遇，共同开创互利共赢、绿色繁荣的全球矿业美好未来。在津期间，何立峰还调研了中新天津生态城、天津滨海－中关村科技园、国家级经开区、综合保税区建设运营情况。
text_en: Jinshi Data, September 10 - He Lifeng, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended and delivered a speech on September 10 in Tianjin at the opening ceremony of the Ministerial Forum on International Mining Cooperation and the 2026 China International Mining Conference. He Lifeng pointed out that international mining cooperation is an important vehicle for realizing complementary resource advantages among countries and promoting economic and social development, and is also a practical necessity for safeguarding the security and stability of global production and supply chains. China has always fully respected the mineral resource sovereignty of all countries and supports all countries in independently choosing resource development and industrial development paths suited to their national conditions. It is willing to deepen all-round practical cooperation with all countries, share mining development opportunities, and jointly create a mutually beneficial, win-win, green and prosperous future for global mining. During his stay in Tianjin, He Lifeng also inspected the China-Singapore Tianjin Eco-City, the Tianjin Binhai-Zhongguancun Science and Technology Park, and the construction and operation of national-level economic and technological development zones and comprehensive bonded zones.
